sentences.text:
Petitioners
 Through: Mr. M K Perwez and Mr, J A
 Chaduhary, Advs.
 versus
 State Nct Of Delhi & Anr. .....

Respondents  Through: Mr. Sanjeev Bhandari, ASC (Crl.)
 with Mr, Kunal Mittal and Mr.
 Saurabh Tanwar, Advs.
 Insp. B. Rai, PS Chandni Mahal  R-2 in person  CORAM:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANISH DAYAL  ORDER % 21.03.2023 1.

This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.237/2022, under section 307/498A/406/506/34 IPC, registered in P.S. Chandni Mahal on the ground of settlement arrived at between the parties vide settlement deed dated 3rd December, 2022 which is on record of this Court.
2. Petitioner No. 1 and respondent No. 2 were married but their marriage has now been dissolved on 3rd December, 2022 vide Khula Mubarat.
3. Petitioner nos. 1 to 3 and respondent no. 2-complainant are present in the Court and have been duly identified by the counsel and the IO.

Respondent no. 2 confirms the factum of settlement and states that all aspects of settlement have been taken care of and now nothing is further due from the petitioner no.1 and she has no objection to quashing of the FIR.

4. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Consequently, the FIR No.237/2022, under section 307/498A/406/506/34 IPC, registered in P.S. Chandni Mahal and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
5. Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
